summary: Across 3 campaigns to technical founders at Series A-C B2B startups with an agent-platform GTM hypothesis, leading with the agent-learning loop and audit-chain visibility outperformed generic automation copy on positive-reply rate by 3-4x. The lift is consistent across 3 distinct send cohorts (165 sends total) and the variant continued to refine upward as one verified company signal was added. Pattern qualifies for skill proposal under the detect_gtm_pattern threshold (>=3 reinforcing observations across distinct campaigns).
counterexamples: Did not generalise to non-technical founders in the same employer segment (campaign 2 sub-cohort): they replied at the control rate, suggesting the lift is specific to the technical-founder persona, not the company type.
